Esbjerg Medicinsk Mave og Tarm Amb. (Esbjerg Medical Gastroenterology Ambulatory) is a specialized healthcare facility recognized for its clinical performance in the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in Denmark. Within the national quality assurance framework detailed in the DANIBD 2025 report, the facility is highlighted for its adherence to safety protocols regarding steroid treatments [^src1].

Specifically, the clinic achieved the highest department-level compliance for Quality Indicator 4, which tracks the proportion of patients receiving DEXA scans during steroid courses [^src1]. DEXA scans are critical for monitoring bone density in patients taking steroids, a medication class that carries a risk of bone loss. For the 2023/24 reporting period, Esbjerg Medicinsk Mave og Tarm Amb. recorded a 54% scan rate among steroid courses, making it the best-performing local department for this specific quality indicator [^src1].

This achievement reflects a broader national initiative to ensure evidence-based and standardized follow-up for IBD patients, particularly those receiving potentially risky medications like steroids or advanced therapies [^src1]. While the clinic excelled in this specific metric, the national reporting framework continues to evaluate and refine these indicators in dialogue with professional societies to improve overall patient care [^src1].
